notes.title: Soundtrack + Mac and Linux Release
notes.notes:
We are happy to launch a POOF VS THE CURSED KITTY Mac and Linux version on Steam. 
In addition, its frenetic Soundtrack and a Soundtrack Edition is available for the first time!

Enjoy this mix between a tower defense and a platforming action game focused on a hardcore gameplay where Poof, the dog will encounter exponential difficulties (various missions to accomplish and upgrades to unlock) in order to protect its cursed kitten against enemies!

Have a great time!
The Poöf Team

notes.title: Poöf Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Thank you so much for playing Poöf and enjoying it ! 
Thank you also for all your feedbacks (positive and negative), very important to us.

Here are some new and fixed stuff about Poöf:
- The Steam Trading Cards are finally available since begginning of the week.
- The bugged achievements (Saws) are fixed.
- You were a lot to say the "Knife effect" (slowing movement when a knife hits an ennemy) was annoying. So we changed it. It still exists but it is a lot more discrete.
- Fixed crash in Leaderboard.
- Other minor fixes

Eggsplosion of love !
Neko and Arkedo
